about.description: One of the world's top beach bars located uniquely on the Orange Beach, Alabama and Perdido Key, Florida line. This legendary honky tonk has been a landmark since 1964, featuring five stages for live music with country, rock, dance and beach music.

menu.name: Queso Fries
menu.description: Golden fried fries with queso on top.

menu.name: Pretzel Sticks
menu.description: Three Bavarian pretzel sticks served with white queso.

menu.name: Beef or Chicken Nachos
menu.description: Tortillia chips with white queso cheese, topped with your choice of beef or chicken, lettuce, jalapeno peppers, pico de gallo and sour cream.

menu.name: Smoked Tuna Dip
menu.description: Brined Gulf tuna, slow smoked and served up Alabama style with saltine crackers.

menu.name: Flora-Bama Birria Bites
menu.description: Slow-braised, spice-marinated beef birria and melty pepper jack cheese wrapped in a crispy flour tortilla. Served with warm queso for dipping. Four per order.

menu.name: Southwest Chicken Potstickers
menu.description: Six crispy golden potstickers filled with zesty Southwest-seasoned chicken and veggies, served with a side of warm queso for dipping.

menu.name: Chicken and Waffles (SUNDAY ONLY 9a-11a)
menu.description: Crispy golden fried chicken served over warm maple-infused waffles. Finished with a drizzle of Mike's Hot Honey, with butter and syrup on the side for the perfect sweet-heat balance. Only offered on Sundays from 9a - 11a.

menu.name: Build Your Own Bama Burger
menu.description: Cooked to perfection and topped with mushrooms, jalapenos, bacon, cheddar, and swiss. Served on an open faced Challah bun with lettuce, tomato, onion and pickle.

specials.name: Chicken and Waffles
specials.description: Crispy golden fried chicken served over warm maple-infused waffles. Finished with a drizzle of Mike's Hot Honey, with butter and syrup on the side for the perfect sweet-heat balance.
